item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
• The first release of PrayerTimes Pro.
  • The next prayer and the time remaining, always visible in your menu bar.
  • The full day's timetable, the Hijri date and the Qibla, one click away.
  • More than 18 calculation methods, with per-prayer adjustments so the times match your local mosque.
  • Notifications before and at each prayer, with optional full-screen alerts and the adhan.
  • Available in English, Arabic, Indonesian, Persian and Urdu, with locale-aware numerals.

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
• City names now appear in the language you have chosen, instead of falling back to English.
  • Redrawn scenery behind the prayer times, with layered dunes and a truer sense of depth.

item.title: Version 1.1.1
item.description:
• City names resolve correctly in your language even when Apple's geocoder answers in English.
  • Redrawn scenery behind the prayer times, with layered dunes and a truer sense of depth.

item.title: Version 1.1.2
item.description: • Automatic updates work again for the direct download. If you installed from GitHub or Homebrew and updates had stopped arriving, this release restores them.

item.title: Version 1.1.3
item.description: • A maintenance release used to confirm that automatic updates install correctly. No changes to the app itself.

item.title: Version 1.1.4
item.description: • A packaging fix so new versions reach the download page reliably. No changes to the app itself.

item.title: Version 1.1.5
item.description: • The app no longer asks for notification permission on its own. It is requested only when you choose to turn notifications on.

item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description:
• Settings rows stay on one line in Arabic, Persian and Urdu, where longer labels used to push the control onto a second row.
  • Settings respects “Show Menu Icons”, closing up the icon column when you turn icons off.
  • Clearer dividers between settings sections.
  • “Today” and “Fasting” are now translated in all five languages.

item.title: Version 2.0.0
item.description:
• A new look for the home screen: a redesigned timeline, hero and footer.
  • Prayer log — mark each prayer as you pray it, with the day rolling over at Fajr rather than midnight.
  • Streaks and make-up (qadā) tracking, with their own screens and a celebration when the day is complete.
  • A Sunnah & Nawāfil checklist on the home screen.
  • Rebuilt welcome guide, and restyled About, Qibla and Hijri Calendar screens.
  • An accent colour picker and a light/dark override, independent of the system setting.

item.title: Version 3.0.0
item.description:
• Every screen rebuilt on one design system — new typography, retuned colours, and spacing that matches from the menu bar to the last settings row.
  • Settings rebuilt as a proper window, with a sidebar and a search that finds any setting as you type.
  • Redesigned welcome guide, full-screen prayer alert, and Streak and Make-up Prayers screens.
  • A separate adhan for Fajr, quiet hours, snooze defaults, and spoken announcements per prayer.
  • A live 3D Ramadan cannon replacing the pre-rendered video.
  • Refinements throughout the right-to-left layouts in Arabic, Persian and Urdu.
  • Dynamic Type, Increase Contrast and Reduce Motion respected across the app.
  • Now requires macOS 14.

item.title: Version 3.0.1
item.description:
• The download is now signed and notarized as a disk image, not just the app inside it — so macOS no longer warns you when you open the DMG.
  • The Mac App Store build no longer offers an updater it does not have.

item.title: Version 3.1.0
item.description:
• Home opens compact again: the Sunnah & Nawāfil checklist starts collapsed, the panel no longer runs past the bottom of the screen, and the Qibla, Calendar and Settings tabs stay put instead of scrolling out of reach.
  • Snoozing a prayer alert now survives your Mac sleeping, travelling or changing a setting. The reminder used to be dropped silently by the next recalculation.
  • Ramadan alerts — Suhoor, Iftar, Duʿā and Taraweeh — and the Fajr window warning take effect the moment you change them, and turning Fasting Mode off stops them immediately.
  • Changing the app's language or the reminder voice now updates alerts that were already scheduled, so they no longer arrive in the previous language.
  • Prayer alerts stay correct when you travel across time zones, and the adhan no longer plays aloud while your Mac is locked.
  • Islamic event reminders no longer stop arriving after the app has been running a long time.
  • Downloaded adhan clips are checked properly: a failed download reports itself, Retry works, and a damaged file cleans itself up.
  • Siri and Spotlight no longer answer with times from a previous day after your location is lost.
  • Text throughout the app follows your Dynamic Type setting, and Persian, Indonesian and Urdu use correct plural forms.
  • Pasting coordinates works with comma decimals and translated compass letters, so the location the app shows you can be typed back in.
